title: Interactive Commerce Gains Momentum in Brazil as VIVAMOMENTO Establishes a Presence in São Paulo's Vila Olímpia Business District-British Weekly-Leading business information portal
text: 2026-08-04 As Brazil's digital economy continues to evolve, the e-commerce industry is entering a new phase of transformation. More platforms are expanding beyond price-based competition by investing in customer experience, community engagement, and long-term customer relationships. Through loyalty programs, exclusive brand rewards, limited-time promotions, and community engagement initiatives, platforms are seeking to increase user engagement and strengthen customer loyalty. This customer-centric approach is increasingly associated with the broader concept of interactive commerce, which emphasizes engagement, loyalty, and community participation throughout the shopping experience. In line with this trend, VIVAMOMENTO is continuing to advance its localized operations in Brazil. Built around VIVA FLASH, loyalty rewards, brand coupons, and community engagement, the platform aims to deliver a more engaging and rewarding shopping experience while continuously strengthening its local service capabilities. As an important step in its localization strategy, VIVAMOMENTO has established an office in São Paulo's Vila Olímpia business district. The office is currently in its final stages of preparation and is expected to officially begin operations in September 2026. The new office will support user services, brand partnerships, merchant relations, and community operations, further strengthening the platform's long-term growth strategy in the Brazilian market. Vila Olímpia is one of São Paulo's leading business districts and is home to numerous multinational corporations, technology companies, and innovative enterprises. Establishing an office in this area will further enhance VIVAMOMENTO's localized operational capabilities in Brazil while creating a strong foundation for future collaboration with local brands, business partners, and communities. As consumers increasingly value interactive experiences and long-term customer benefits, localized operations and interactive commerce are expected to play an increasingly important role in the continued evolution of Brazil's e-commerce industry.
